title.en: Tic-Tac-Toe Winner: A Table of Lines
title.zh: 井字棋判胜：一张赢线表

blurb.en: Number the squares 0-8, list the eight winning lines as triples of indexes, and test each line in one loop.
blurb.zh: 把九格编号 0–8，把八条赢线写成下标三元组的表，一个循环逐条检查。

en: The board is a list of nine one-character strings, read left to right and top to bottom: square 0 is the top-left corner, square 4 the centre, square 8 the bottom-right. An empty square holds a full stop. Once the board is a flat list, every winning line is just three indexes.

LINES writes all eight lines out by hand: three rows, three columns, two diagonals. The rule of the game now lives in data rather than in code - the loop never needs to know which kind of line it is looking at. That is the whole point of this version; Tic-Tac-Toe Winner with Loops works the same lines out with arithmetic instead.

A line is won when its three squares hold the same mark and that mark is not the empty full stop. The chained comparison board[a] == board[b] == board[c] means board[a] == board[b] and board[b] == board[c]; without the test for the full stop, an empty row would count as a win for nobody.

There are four possible answers: X, O, the string draw when the board is full and nobody has a line, and None while the game is still going. The demo block checks one board of each kind - a top row of X, an O diagonal from the top-right corner, a full board with no line, and a board with just two moves on it.
zh: 棋盘是九个单字符字符串组成的列表，从左到右、从上到下读：0 号是左上角，4 号是正中，8 号是右下角。空格里放一个英文句点。棋盘一旦摊成一维列表，每条赢线就只是三个下标。
LINES 把八条线全部手写出来：三行、三列、两条对角线。游戏规则于是放在数据里而不在代码里——循环根本不必知道手上这条是哪一种线。这就是这个写法的要点；「井字棋判胜：循环逐行逐列」则用算术把同样的八条线算出来。
一条线被赢下，要三格记号相同、而且不是表示空格的句点。连写的比较 board[a] == board[b] == board[c] 等于 board[a] == board[b] and board[b] == board[c]；少了对句点的检查，一整行空格也会被当成有人赢了。
结果有四种：X、O、棋盘下满且无人连成线时的字符串 draw，以及对局还没结束时的 None。演示块每种各查一盘：X 占满最上一行、O 从右上角连成一条对角线、下满却没有连线的一盘、只走了两步的一盘。

lineNotes.en: The two diagonals both pass through square 4, the centre.
lineNotes.zh: 两条对角线都经过 4 号格，也就是正中那一格。

lineNotes.en: Nobody has won and there is still room: the game goes on.
lineNotes.zh: 没人赢、也还有空格：对局继续。

title.zh: 井字棋判胜：循环逐行逐列

blurb.en: The same winner test with no table: a loop over the rows, a loop over the columns, and the two diagonals, all from index arithmetic.
blurb.zh: 同一个判胜，不用表：一个循环看行、一个循环看列，再看两条对角线，下标全靠算术。

en: Row r of the board starts at index 3 * r, so its squares are 3 * r, 3 * r + 1 and 3 * r + 2. Column c starts at index c in the top row and each step down adds 3. Those two facts replace the eight-line table used in Tic-Tac-Toe Winner: A Table of Lines.

The helper same asks one question - are three given squares the same mark, and not empty? - so each loop only has to say which three squares. Pulling the repeated test into a function is what keeps the three checks short.
The diagonals get no loop, because there are only two of them. When either one is won, the mark can be read from the centre square, since both diagonals pass through it - one return serves both.

Put side by side, the two versions trade in opposite directions: the table is easy to check by eye but has to be typed out, and the loops are shorter but ask the reader to trust the arithmetic. The demo block checks five boards: a top row of X, a left column of X, an O diagonal through the centre, a full board with no line, and one that is still going.
zh: 第 r 行从下标 3 * r 开始，三格是 3 * r、3 * r + 1、3 * r + 2。第 c 列在最上一行的下标是 c，往下每走一格加 3。这两条事实取代了「井字棋判胜：一张赢线表」里的八条线表。
辅助函数 same 只回答一个问题：给定的三格是不是同一个记号、而且不是空格？于是每个循环只需说清是哪三格。把重复的判断抽进一个函数，三处检查才都这么短。
对角线不写循环，因为只有两条。任何一条连成时，记号都可以从正中那一格读，因为两条对角线都经过它——一个 return 管两条。
两个写法并排看，取舍正好相反：表一眼就能核对，但得一条条敲出来；循环更短，但要读者相信那几个算式。演示块查五盘：X 占满最上一行、X 占满最左一列、O 连成过正中的对角线、下满却没有连线的一盘、还在进行中的一盘。

lineNotes.en: The first square of row r - any of its three would do.
lineNotes.zh: 第 r 行的第一格——三格里随便取哪格都一样。

lineNotes.en: Both diagonals run through square 4.
lineNotes.zh: 两条对角线都经过 4 号格。

blurb.en: A whole game for two people at one keyboard: read a move, reject a bad one, place it, decide whether the game is over, swap players.
blurb.zh: 两个人共用一个键盘下完整的一局：读一步、拒绝不合法的、落子、判断是否结束、换人。

en: The game is driven by one variable, state. It starts as playing and the main loop runs for as long as it keeps that value. Each pass shows the board, reads one move and places it, then decides the next state: a win, a draw, or still playing with the other side to move. This is the game loop written as a small state machine - what matters is not how many times the loop runs but which state the game is in.

read_move does not return until it has a legal move. The reply must be all digits and between 1 and 9, and the square must still be empty; anything else prints a reason and asks again. isdecimal is checked before int is called, so a reply like x never reaches int and never raises an error.

Only the player who has just moved can have made a new line, so the win test compares winner(board) with player rather than asking about both sides. The draw test comes second: a move that fills the last square and also completes a line is a win, not a draw.

The demo block plays two games. To play them yourself: in the first, X takes square 5 and O takes 1; X then types x, then 5 (already taken), then 10, and each is refused before X settles on 9; O plays 2, X 3, O 7, and X completes the right-hand column with 6. In the second, the moves 1, 5, 9, 2, 8, 7, 3, 6, 4 fill the board with no line, so it ends in a draw. When the moves come from a file or a pipe instead - which is how the program is checked - input() does not echo them, so each prompt is followed directly by whatever is printed next.
zh: 整局由一个变量 state 驱动。它一开始是 playing，主循环在它保持这个值时一直跑。每一轮显示棋盘、读一步并落子，然后决定下一个状态：有人赢、平局，或者仍在进行、换另一方走。这就是写成小状态机的游戏循环——要紧的不是循环跑了几次，而是对局处在哪个状态。
read_move 拿到合法的一步之前不返回。回复必须全是数字、介于 1 到 9 之间，而且那一格还得空着；否则打印原因、重新问。先查 isdecimal 再调用 int，所以像 x 这样的回复根本到不了 int，也就不会抛错。
只有刚落子的一方可能新连成一条线，所以判胜直接拿 winner(board) 和 player 比，不必两方都问。判平排在后面：填满最后一格同时又连成一条线的那一步算赢，不算平。
演示块下两局。自己来下：第一局 X 下 5、O 下 1；X 接着敲 x、再敲 5（已被占）、再敲 10，三次都被拒绝，然后下 9；O 下 2、X 下 3、O 下 7，X 用 6 连成最右一列。第二局依次下 1、5、9、2、8、7、3、6、4，下满也没有连线，以平局结束。如果这些输入是从文件或管道喂进去的（检查程序就是这样跑的），input() 不回显它们，每个提示语后面就紧跟着下一段输出。

lineNotes.en: and stops at the first false part, so int only ever sees digits.
lineNotes.zh: and 遇到第一个假就停，所以 int 只会见到数字。

lineNotes.en: The index comes straight from read_move, already checked.
lineNotes.zh: 下标直接来自 read_move，已经检查过了。

blurb.en: Score a position by trying every move, every reply and every reply to that, assuming both sides always choose their best.
blurb.zh: 给一个局面打分：试遍每一步、每一种回应、回应的回应，并假设双方每次都挑对自己最好的。

en: minimax scores a position from X's point of view: 1 if X will win, 0 if it will be a draw, -1 if O will win - always assuming both sides play perfectly from here on. X wants the score as high as possible, O wants it as low as possible; the names min and max come from those two wishes.

A finished position scores itself: a line for X, a line for O, or a full board. Any other position is scored by trying every empty square: make the move on a new board, score what follows with the other side to move, and keep the best score for the side whose turn it is. The game tree splits naturally into smaller trees - each move leaves a smaller game - which is why the function calls itself; the finished positions are the base cases. How recursion works in general is on the Recursion page; here it is only used.

Every move is tried on a fresh board built by slicing, so the board passed in is never changed. The search is complete but not fast: from an empty board it visits over half a million positions. The demo block therefore starts from positions a few moves in.

best_move plays X: it tries each empty square and keeps the first one with the highest score. In the demo it takes the winning square 3 when X already has 1 and 2 (score 1); it blocks O's top row at square 3 and still wins (score 1); after X in a corner and O on the edge next to it, it finds a forced win starting at square 2 (score 1); and after X in a corner and O in the centre, the best X can get is a draw (score 0).
zh: minimax 站在 X 的角度给局面打分：X 必胜为 1、平局为 0、O 必胜为 -1——前提是双方从这里起都下得完美。X 想让分数尽量高，O 想让它尽量低；min 与 max 这两个名字就来自这两个愿望。
终局自己给自己打分：X 连成线、O 连成线、或者下满。其他局面就试遍每一个空格：在一个新棋盘上走这一步、以轮到另一方的身份给之后的局面打分，再按轮到谁挑出对他最好的那个分数。博弈树天然分成更小的树——每走一步都剩下一盘更小的棋——所以这个函数调用自己；终局就是基例。递归的机制见「递归」一页，这里只是用它。
每一步都在切片拼出来的新棋盘上试，所以传进来的 board 从来不被改动。这种搜索是完备的，但不快：从空棋盘开始要走过五十多万个局面。所以演示块都从已经下了几步的局面开始。
best_move 替 X 下：试每一个空格，留下分数最高的第一个。演示里：X 已占 1、2 号时，它下 3 号直接赢（分数 1）；它在 3 号挡住 O 的第一行，而且仍然能赢（分数 1）；X 在角、O 在紧挨着的边上时，它找到从 2 号开始的必胜（分数 1）；X 在角、O 在正中时，X 最多只能和棋（分数 0）。

lineNotes.en: After this move it will be the other side's turn.
lineNotes.zh: 这一步之后就轮到另一方了。

lineNotes.en: O's turn: O picks the score that is worst for X.
lineNotes.zh: 轮到 O：O 挑对 X 最不利的那个分数。

blurb.en: You think of a number from 1 to 100; the computer halves the range after every answer and never needs more than seven guesses.
blurb.zh: 你心里想一个 1 到 100 的数；电脑每得到一个回答就把范围砍半，从不需要超过七次。

en: The computer keeps the range of numbers that could still be yours, from low to high, and always guesses the middle one. The reply h means your number is higher, so everything up to and including the guess is ruled out; l means lower, which rules out the guess and everything above it; c ends the game.

Each answer at least halves the range, and 100 numbers can be halved only seven times before one is left, so seven guesses are always enough. This is binary search with a person answering the comparisons; binary search itself is covered on the Searching page.

If the answers contradict each other, low ends up above high and the loop stops with nothing left to guess; the program says so instead of guessing a number that has already been ruled out. A reply other than h, l or c is refused and does not count as a try: continue jumps back to the top of the loop, and since low and high are unchanged the same number is asked again.

The demo block plays three rounds. To play them yourself: think of 37 and answer l, h, c - found on the third guess. Then think of 100 and answer h, h, then a word like yes (refused), then h, h, h, h, c - seven guesses, the most it ever needs. Then answer l, h, h, l, h, h, l, which no number fits, and the computer reports it. When the answers come from a file or a pipe - which is how the program is checked - input() does not echo them, so each prompt is followed directly by the next one.
zh: 电脑记住你的数可能落在的范围 low 到 high，每次都猜正中间那个。回答 h 表示你的数更大，于是猜的数以及它以下的都被排除；l 表示更小，排除猜的数以及它以上的；c 结束这一局。
每个回答至少把范围砍掉一半，100 个数最多砍七次就只剩一个，所以七次一定够。这就是由人来回答比较结果的二分查找；二分查找本身在「查找」一页讲过。
如果回答自相矛盾，low 最后会跑到 high 上面，循环因为没数可猜而停下；程序会说出来，而不是去猜一个已被排除的数。h、l、c 以外的回复会被拒绝、也不算一次：continue 跳回循环开头，low 和 high 没变，于是再问一遍同一个数。
演示块玩三局。自己来玩：心里想 37，依次回答 l、h、c——第三次猜中。再想 100，回答 h、h，接着敲一个词比如 yes（被拒绝），再回答 h、h、h、h、c——七次，这是它最多需要的次数。最后回答 l、h、h、l、h、h、l，没有哪个数符合，电脑会说出来。如果这些回答是从文件或管道喂进去的（检查程序就是这样跑的），input() 不回显它们，每个提示语后面就紧跟着下一个。

lineNotes.en: Back to the top without counting a try; the same guess is asked again.
lineNotes.zh: 不计次数，回到循环开头；同一个数再问一遍。

lineNotes.en: Lower: the guess and everything above it are ruled out.
lineNotes.zh: 更小：猜的数以及它以上的都被排除。

blurb.en: Pick a word with a seeded random generator, show it with the unguessed letters hidden, and read one letter at a time until it is solved or the lives run out.
blurb.zh: 用带种子的随机数生成器选一个词，把没猜到的字母遮住显示，一次读一个字母，直到猜出或命用完。

en: The state of a game is small: the secret word, the set of letters tried so far, and the lives left. Everything shown on the screen is worked out from those three - mask builds the hidden version of the word from the word and the set, so there is no second copy of the word to keep in step.

mask is a pure function: the same word and the same guesses always give the same result, and it prints nothing and reads nothing. That is why it can be checked on its own, while play, which reads input and prints, is the part that only runs the game.

The word is chosen by rng = random.Random(2026), a random generator with a fixed seed, and never by the module-level random functions. With this seed the first word is python and the second is function; change the seed and different words come out. A fixed seed is what lets the same run be repeated and checked.

Replies are tidied with strip and lower before anything else, so T counts as t. A reply that is not exactly one letter is refused, and so is a letter already tried; neither costs a life. To play the demo yourself: for python with 6 lives type e (a miss), p, y, then ab (refused), p again (already tried), then T, h, o, n to win with 5 lives left; for function with 3 lives type a, u, s, z - three misses and one hit, which uses up every life. When the letters come from a file or a pipe - which is how the program is checked - input() does not echo them.
zh: 一局的状态很小：秘密词、已经试过的字母集合、剩下的命。屏幕上显示的一切都由这三样算出来——mask 用词和集合拼出遮住的那一版，所以不必再维护一份需要同步的词。
mask 是纯函数：同样的词和同样的已猜字母永远给出同样的结果，它不打印也不读输入。所以它能被单独检验；而读输入、做打印的 play 只负责把游戏跑起来。
词由 rng = random.Random(2026) 选出——一个种子固定的随机数生成器，而不是模块级的 random 函数。用这个种子，第一局的词是 python、第二局是 function；换一个种子，选出的词就不一样。固定种子才让同一次运行可以重复、可以核对。

回复先用 strip 和 lower 整理，所以 T 当 t 算。不是恰好一个字母的回复会被拒绝，已经试过的字母也会；这两种都不扣命。自己玩演示：python、6 条命，依次敲 e（没中）、p、y，再敲 ab（被拒绝）、再敲 p（已试过），然后 T、h、o、n，剩 5 条命猜出；function、3 条命，敲 a、u、s、z——三次没中、一次命中，命全部用完。如果这些字母是从文件或管道喂进去的（检查程序就是这样跑的），input() 不回显它们。

lineNotes.en: A letter not yet guessed shows as an underscore.
lineNotes.zh: 还没猜到的字母显示成下划线。

lineNotes.en: A generator of its own with a fixed seed: the same words every run.
lineNotes.zh: 自己的一个生成器、种子固定：每次运行选出的词都一样。

blurb.en: Slide one row to the left in three passes: drop the zeros, merge equal neighbours from the left, then pad the end with zeros.
blurb.zh: 一行向左滑，分三步：去掉 0、从左往右合并相等的邻居、末尾补 0。

en: In 2048 a move slides every tile as far as it will go, and two equal tiles that meet become one tile worth their sum, which is added to the score. This version does it in stages that can each be checked: first a list of just the tiles with the gaps squeezed out, then a walk along that list merging pairs, then zeros added back until the row is its old length.

The rule that catches people out is that a tile merges at most once per move. When a pair merges the index jumps past both tiles, so the new tile is never looked at again in this move: the row 2, 2, 2, 2 becomes 4, 4, 0, 0 (score 8), never 8, 0, 0, 0. With three equal tiles the two on the left merge: 2, 2, 2, 0 becomes 4, 2, 0, 0 (score 4).

Squeezing first is what lets tiles with gaps between them merge: 4, 0, 4, 8 becomes 8, 8, 0, 0 (score 8), and the new 8 does not then merge with the 8 already there. A row with no equal neighbours, such as 2, 4, 8, 16, comes back unchanged with score 0, and so does an empty row.
The function returns a new list and never changes the row it was given. The same rule is written as a single pass with an output stack in 2048 Row: An Output Stack.
zh: 2048 里一次移动把每块都尽量滑到底，两块相等的相遇就合成一块、值是两者之和，并加进得分。这个写法分阶段做，每一段都能单独核对：先得到挤掉空格、只剩数字块的列表，再沿这个列表逐对合并，最后补 0 补回原来的长度。
最容易出错的规则是：一次移动里每块最多合并一次。一对合并之后下标跳过这两块，新块在这次移动中不会再被看到：2, 2, 2, 2 变成 4, 4, 0, 0（得 8 分），而不是 8, 0, 0, 0。三块相等时左边两块合并：2, 2, 2, 0 变成 4, 2, 0, 0（得 4 分）。
先挤掉空格，隔着空格的两块才能合并：4, 0, 4, 8 变成 8, 8, 0, 0（得 8 分），新出现的 8 也不会再和原来那块 8 合并。没有相等邻居的行（比如 2, 4, 8, 16）原样返回、得 0 分，全空的行也一样。
这个函数返回一个新列表，从不改动传进来的那一行。同一条规则写成「一遍扫过 + 输出栈」的版本见「2048 一行：输出栈」。

lineNotes.en: No partner: keep this tile as it is and move on by one.
lineNotes.zh: 没有搭档：这一块原样保留，下标只走一步。

lineNotes.en: Pad with zeros back to the row's original length.
lineNotes.zh: 补 0，补回这一行原来的长度。

blurb.en: The same row rule in one pass: push each tile onto an output list, merging it into the top instead when they are equal and the top has not just merged.
blurb.zh: 同一条规则一遍做完：每块压进输出列表；若与栈顶相等、且栈顶不是刚合并出来的，就改为合进栈顶。

en: out is used as a stack: tiles only ever go on at the end, and only the last one, out[-1], is ever looked at. Walking along the row, a zero is skipped with continue, and any other tile either merges into the top of the stack or is pushed on top of it.

The flag just_merged is what enforces one merge per tile per move. Take the row 4, 0, 4, 8: the two 4s merge into an 8 on top of the stack, and then the next tile is also an 8. Without the flag that 8 would merge straight into the new one, giving a single 16; with it the row becomes 8, 8, 0, 0 with score 8, exactly as in 2048 Row: Squeeze, Merge, Pad.

The flag is cleared whenever a tile is pushed, because the new top has not merged with anything yet. Merging changes the top in place rather than popping it and pushing the sum - the length of out does not change, only its last value.

The demo rows are the same five as in the other version and give the same results: 4, 4, 0, 0 with score 8; 4, 2, 0, 0 with score 4; 8, 8, 0, 0 with score 8; and the last two rows unchanged with score 0. Two different pieces of code agreeing on the same awkward rows is a good sign that both follow the rule.
zh: out 当栈用：块只从末尾放进去，也只看最后一块 out[-1]。沿着这一行走，0 用 continue 跳过，其余每块要么合进栈顶，要么压到栈顶上。
标志 just_merged 保证每块每次移动只合并一次。看 4, 0, 4, 8 这一行：两块 4 合成栈顶的一块 8，接下来那一块也是 8。没有标志，这块 8 会直接合进新出来的那块，变成一块 16；有了标志，这一行变成 8, 8, 0, 0、得 8 分，和「2048 一行：挤、合、补」完全一样。
每压进一块就把标志清掉，因为新的栈顶还没和任何块合并过。合并时直接改栈顶，而不是先 pop 再压进和——out 的长度不变，只是最后一个值变了。
演示的五行与另一个版本相同，结果也相同：4, 4, 0, 0 得 8 分；4, 2, 0, 0 得 4 分；8, 8, 0, 0 得 8 分；最后两行原样、得 0 分。两段不同的代码在同样刁钻的行上意见一致，说明两者都守住了规则。

lineNotes.en: Gaps take no part in merging.
lineNotes.zh: 空格不参与合并。

lineNotes.en: A freshly pushed tile has not merged yet.
lineNotes.zh: 刚压进去的块还没合并过。

blurb.en: Moving right, up or down is moving left on a rearranged board: reverse the rows for right, transpose for up, both for down.
blurb.zh: 向右、向上、向下都是在重排过的棋盘上向左：向右反转每行，向上转置，向下两样都做。

en: Only one direction is written out in full: merge_left slides and merges a single row to the left, following the rule in 2048 Row: Squeeze, Merge, Pad. Every other direction reuses it by rearranging the board first and undoing the rearrangement afterwards.

Moving right is moving left on each row read backwards, so the row is reversed with a slice whose step is -1, merged, and the result reversed back. Moving up is moving left on the columns: transpose turns columns into rows, the rows are merged, and transposing again turns them back into columns. Moving down combines the two.

transpose relies on zip(*board): the star passes each row as a separate argument, and zip then hands back the first items of every row together, then the second items, and so on - which are exactly the columns. zip gives tuples, so each one is turned into a list.

move always builds a new board and never changes the one passed in, so the demo can apply all four directions to the same starting board. Moving left, the top row 2, 0, 2, 4 becomes 4, 4, 0, 0 and the row 0, 4, 4, 4 becomes 8, 4, 0, 0; moving up, the first column 2, 0, 2, 8 becomes 4, 8, 0, 0.
zh: 只有一个方向是完整写出来的：merge_left 把一行向左滑并合并，规则同「2048 一行：挤、合、补」。其余方向都复用它：先把棋盘重排一下，做完再把重排撤回去。
向右等于把每行倒过来读、再向左，所以用步长 -1 的切片反转这一行、合并、再把结果反回去。向上等于在列上向左：transpose 把列变成行，逐行合并，再转置一次把它们变回列。向下就是两样合起来。
transpose 靠的是 zip(*board)：星号把每一行拆成单独的实参，zip 于是先交回每行的第一个元素组成的一组，再交回每行的第二个元素……这正是一列一列。zip 给的是元组，所以每组都转成列表。
move 总是造一个新棋盘，从不改动传进来的那个，所以演示能对同一个起始棋盘依次试四个方向。向左时，第一行 2, 0, 2, 4 变成 4, 4, 0, 0，0, 4, 4, 4 那一行变成 8, 4, 0, 0；向上时，第一列 2, 0, 2, 8 变成 4, 8, 0, 0。

lineNotes.en: Left needs no rearranging at all.
lineNotes.zh: 向左完全不需要重排。

lineNotes.at: return transpose([merge_left(row[::-1])[::-1] for row in transpose(board)])
lineNotes.en: Down: transpose, move right, transpose back.
lineNotes.zh: 向下：转置、向右、再转置回来。

title.en: Minesweeper: Lay the Mines and Count

blurb.en: Place the mines with rng.sample, keeping the first click and its neighbours clear, then give every other square the number of mines around it.
blurb.zh: 用 rng.sample 布雷，并让首次点击的格子与它的邻格保持无雷；再给其余每一格标上周围的雷数。

en: Squares are (x, y) tuples: x counts across from the left, y counts down from the top. The mines are a set of these tuples, so asking whether a square holds a mine is a single in test. neighbours returns the up to eight squares around one square, leaving out the square itself and anything off the edge of the board.

place_mines first makes the set of squares that must stay safe - the first click and its neighbours - and then draws the mines from every other square with rng.sample, which picks the requested number of different items in one go. Keeping the neighbours clear too means the first click always lands on a 0 and opens a patch of the board, which is how real Minesweeper plays.

counts works inwards: for each square that is not a mine it looks at that square's neighbours and counts how many are mines. A mine is marked -1 in the grid, a value no count can take. The randomness stays in place_mines; counts gets a plain set of mines, so the same set always gives the same grid.

The demo block uses random.Random(7) to lay 10 mines on a board 9 squares wide and 6 high, with the first click in the top-left corner. With this seed the top-left corner comes out as a patch of zeros, as the rule promises; another seed would lay the mines elsewhere, but that corner would still be clear.
zh: 格子用 (x, y) 元组表示：x 从左往右数，y 从上往下数。雷是这些元组组成的集合，问某格有没有雷只要一次 in。neighbours 交回某格周围最多八个格子，不含它自己、也不含出了边界的。
place_mines 先做出必须安全的格子集合——首次点击的那格与它的邻格——再用 rng.sample 从其余格子里一次抽出指定个数、互不相同的位置当雷。连邻格也保持无雷，首次点击就一定落在 0 上、翻开一片，真正的扫雷就是这样玩的。
counts 是往里数的：对每个不是雷的格子，看它的邻格里有几个雷。雷在网格里记作 -1，这是任何雷数都取不到的值。随机只留在 place_mines 里；counts 拿到的是一个普通的雷集合，同一个集合永远给出同一张网格。
演示块用 random.Random(7) 在宽 9 格、高 6 格的棋盘上布 10 颗雷，首次点击在左上角。用这个种子，左上角是一片 0，正如规则保证的那样；换一个种子雷会落到别处，但那个角照样是空的。

lineNotes.at: if (dx, dy) != (0, 0) and 0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h:
lineNotes.en: Skip the square itself, and anything off the board.
lineNotes.zh: 跳过自己，也跳过出界的格子。

lineNotes.en: -1 marks a mine: no real count is ever negative.
lineNotes.zh: -1 标记雷：真正的雷数不会是负的。

blurb.en: Clicking a 0 opens every square connected to it through other 0s, plus the numbered border around them - a breadth-first search over the grid.
blurb.zh: 点到 0 时，把经由其他 0 连在一起的所有格子、连同它们外圈带数字的边都翻开——这是在网格上做的广度优先搜索。

en: The grid is a list of rows, so a square is read as grid[y][x] - the row first, then the column - while positions are still written as (x, y). FIELD holds the board as text, with an asterisk for a mine, and the demo block turns it into numbers with -1 for each mine.

Clicking a mine opens nothing and the function returns None. Clicking a number opens just that square. Clicking a 0 spreads: the squares form a graph in which each square is joined to its neighbours, and the queue visits them breadth first, exactly as in the Graph Algorithms page - the set opened doubles as the visited set, so no square joins the queue twice.

Only a 0 passes the spread on. A numbered square is opened when it is reached but its own neighbours are not added, which is why the opened patch ends in a border of numbers. A 0 never has a mine next to it - that is what the 0 means - so the flood can never open a mine.
In the demo, clicking the 0 at (4, 1) opens 41 of the 48 squares in one go; clicking the 1 in the top-left corner opens just that one square; clicking (1, 0) hits a mine.
zh: 网格是由行组成的列表，所以读一格要写 grid[y][x]——先行后列——而位置仍写成 (x, y)。FIELD 用文本存棋盘、星号表示雷，演示块把它转成数字，雷记为 -1。
点到雷什么都不翻开，函数返回 None。点到数字只翻开那一格。点到 0 就扩散：格子构成一张图，每格与它的邻格相连，队列按广度优先依次访问它们，和「图算法」一页的写法完全一样——集合 opened 同时充当已访问集合，所以没有哪一格会入队两次。
只有 0 会把扩散传下去。带数字的格子被碰到时会翻开，但它的邻格不会被加进来，所以翻开的那一片外面总围着一圈数字。0 的旁边一定没有雷——这正是 0 的意思——所以扩散永远翻不到雷。
演示中，点 (4, 1) 那个 0，一下子翻开 48 格中的 41 格；点左上角的 1，只翻开那一格；点 (1, 0) 则踩到了雷。

lineNotes.en: A deque: popleft is quick, which a plain list's pop(0) is not.
lineNotes.zh: deque：popleft 很快，普通列表的 pop(0) 不是。

lineNotes.en: Marked as opened when it joins the queue, not when it leaves, so it can never join twice.
lineNotes.zh: 入队时就标记为已翻开，而不是出队时，所以它不会入队两次。

blurb.en: Two computer players race to 100 at Pig: keep rolling to build up a turn total, but a 1 wipes it out. Which is better, holding at 20 or rolling three times?
blurb.zh: 两个电脑玩家玩 Pig 骰子、先到 100 者胜：一直掷可以攒这一轮的分，但掷出 1 就全部作废。到 20 就停好，还是每轮掷三次好？

en: On each turn a player rolls a die again and again, adding each roll to a turn total. Rolling a 1 ends the turn and the turn total is lost; choosing to stop - holding - adds the turn total to the player's score. The first to reach 100 wins.

A strategy is a function that answers one question: given the turn total so far and the number of rolls so far, stop now? The two strategies are passed to play as values in a list, and take_turn calls whichever one belongs to the current player - swapping strategies needs no change to the game code.

All the dice come from one generator, rng = random.Random(100), created in the demo block and passed down to every function that needs it. Every run therefore rolls the same dice in the same order; with a different seed the numbers would change.

Going first is an advantage, so the demo alternates who starts over 1000 games. The index returned by play belongs to whoever went first that game, which is why the odd-numbered games map it back with 1 minus the index. With this seed holding at 20 wins 665 of the 1000 games and rolling three times wins 335.
zh: 每一轮，玩家一次又一次掷骰子，把每次的点数加进这一轮的累计。掷出 1 这一轮结束、累计作废；选择停下（hold）就把这一轮的累计加进总分。先到 100 的人赢。
策略是一个函数，只回答一个问题：这一轮到目前的累计和掷过的次数是这样，现在停不停？两个策略装在列表里当作值传给 play，take_turn 调用轮到的那名玩家的那一个——换策略不用改游戏代码。
所有骰子都来自同一个生成器 rng = random.Random(100)，它在演示块里创建，再作为实参传给每个需要它的函数。所以每次运行掷出的骰子、顺序都一样；换一个种子，数字就会变。
先手有优势，所以演示在 1000 局里轮流先手。play 交回的下标是按那一局的先后排的，所以奇数局要用 1 减去它换回来。用这个种子，到 20 就停赢了 1000 局中的 665 局，每轮掷三次赢了 335 局。

lineNotes.en: randint includes both ends: 1 to 6.
lineNotes.zh: randint 两端都含：1 到 6。

lineNotes.en: The strategy is just a function value: call it like any other.
lineNotes.zh: 策略就是一个函数值：像别的函数一样调用它。

run.expect:
hold at 20: 665 wins out of 1000
three rolls: 335 wins out of 1000
